name: consultorio-app
description: Sistema de gestión del consultorio médico

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n "FRONTEND,BACKEND" -c "cyan,green" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix backend"
scripts.build: npm run prisma:generate --workspace=consultorio-app-backend && npm run build --workspace=consultorio-app-backend && npm run build --workspace=consultorio-app-frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=consultorio-app-backend && npm run typecheck --workspace=consultorio-app-frontend
